option_relations.rationale: Emulsified silicone oil in a lamellar macular hole is a specific instance of a lamellar macular hole with trapped silicone oil.
Lamellar macular hole with trapped silicone oil is directly described by the leaf with ID B4.2.
Hyperoleon within a lamellar macular hole can be considered a specific type of lamellar macular hole with trapped silicone oil, given the context of silicone oil.
Silicone oil-induced maculopathy is a broader condition and not directly related to the specific scenario of a lamellar macular hole with trapped silicone oil described by leaf B4.2.
